uz.text: 1. Mazkur Nizom texnikumlarni muvaffaqiyatli tamomlagan bitiruvchilarni (keyingi oʻrinlarda - bitiruvchilar) oʻz sohasiga mone bakalavriat taʻlim yoʻnalishlariga kirish imtixonlarisiz, yakka tartibdagi suhbat orqali oliy taʻlim muassasalarining 2-bosqichidan oʻqishini davom ettirish uchun qabul qilish tartibini belgilaydi.

ru.text: 1. Mazkur Nizom texnikumlarni muvaffaqiyatli tamomlagan bitiruvchilarni (keyingi o‘rinlarda - bitiruvchilar) o‘z sohasiga mone bakalavriat ta’lim yo‘nalishlariga kirish imtixonlarisiz, yakka tartibdagi suhbat orqali oliy ta’lim muassasalarining 2-bosqichidan o‘qishini davom ettirish uchun qabul qilish tartibini belgilaydi.

en.text: 1. This Regulation establishes the procedure for admitting graduates who have successfully completed technical colleges (hereinafter — graduates) to continue their studies from the 2nd year of higher education institutions, in bachelor’s degree programmes corresponding to their field, without entrance examinations, through an individual interview.

uz.text: Ushbu Nizom oliy xarbiy, oliy xarbiylashtirilgan taʻlim muassasalariga, Toshkent davlat yuridik universitetiga, Oʻzbekistonda faoliyat olib borayotgan xorijiy va nodavlat oliy taʻlim tashkilotlari hamda ularning filiallariga nisbatan tatbiq etilmaydi.

ru.text: Ushbu Nizom oliy xarbiy, oliy xarbiylashtirilgan ta’lim muassasalariga, Toshkent davlat yuridik universitetiga, O‘zbekistonda faoliyat olib borayotgan xorijiy va nodavlat oliy ta’lim tashkilotlari hamda ularning filiallariga nisbatan tatbiq etilmaydi.

en.text: This Regulation does not apply to higher military and higher paramilitary educational institutions, Tashkent State University of Law, foreign and non-state higher education organisations operating in Uzbekistan and their branches.

items: Bitiruvchilar oliy taʻlim muassasalarining 2-bosqichidan oʻqishni davom ettirishi mumkin boʻlgan oʻz sohasiga mos bakalavriat taʻlim yoʻnalishlari roʻyxati Oʻzbekiston Respublikasi Oliy va oʻrta maxsus taʻlim vazirligi tomonidan tasdiqlanadi.

Bitiruvchilarni oliy taʻlim muassasalariga kirish imtixonlarisiz, yakka tartibdagi suhbat orqali bakalavriat taʻlim yoʻnalishlarining 2-bosqichidan oʻqishga qabul qilish toʻlov-kontrakt asosida amalga oshiriladi.

The list of bachelor’s degree programmes corresponding to their field in which graduates may continue their studies from the 2nd year of higher education institutions is approved by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialised Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Graduates are admitted to the 2nd year of bachelor’s degree programmes without entrance examinations, through an individual interview, on a paid-contract basis.

en.text: The tuition fee under the paid-contract form of study is set on the basis of the costs of training one student.

en.text: 4. Graduates who have successfully completed a technical college are those whose grades at the end of the academic semesters throughout their studies at the technical college are “5 (excellent)” and “4 (good)”, provided that at least 50 percent of the grades (at least 85 percent for medical higher education institutions) are “5 (excellent)”.

en.text: Starting from the 2021/2022 academic year, the procedure for admitting graduates to bachelor’s degree programmes of higher education institutions without entrance examinations, through an individual interview, applies for two years from the year of graduation from the technical college.

en.text: Persons who do not belong to the above category and who graduated from a technical college more than two years ago are admitted to bachelor’s degree programmes of higher education institutions, when they express a wish to study, in accordance with the general procedure.

Bitiruvchilar har yili 5 iyuldan 25 iyulga qadar O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Oliy va o‘rta maxsus ta’lim vazirligining rasmiy veb-sayti orqali onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tadilar.

Every year, from July 5 to July 25, graduates register online through the official website of the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialised Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
When registering for bachelor’s degree programmes of higher education institutions, graduates are required to enter their personal data into the system and upload the following documents:

en.text: a document on graduation from the technical college and a copy of its appendix.

uz.text: Oliy va oʻrta maxsus taʻlim vazirligi tomonidan vazirlikning rasmiy veb-sayti orqali bitiruvchilarni roʻyxatdan oʻtkazish jarayonlari muvofiqlashtirilib boriladi.

en.text: The registration of graduates is coordinated by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialised Education through the Ministry’s official website.

items: Onlayn roʻyxatdan oʻtgan bitiruvchilarning tizimga yuklangan hujjatlari oliy taʻlim muassasalari qabul komissiyalari tomonidan har yili 5 avgustga qadar oʻrganib chiqiladi va oʻrganish natijalari boʻyicha abiturientlarning shaxsiy kabineti orqali ularga xabar beriladi.

Bitiruvchilar tomonidan topshirilgan hujjatlarning qalbakiligi aniqlanganda, u suhbatdan (talabalikka qabul qilingandan keyin aniqlansa, talabalikdan) chetlashtiriladi hamda hujjatlari belgilangan tartibda huquqni muhofaza qiluvchi oʻrganlarga yuboriladi.

Onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan bitiruvchilarning tizimga yuklangan xujjatlari oliy ta’lim muassasalari qabul komissiyalari tomonidan har yili 5 avgustga qadar o‘rganib chiqiladi va o‘rganish natijalari bo‘yicha abiturientlarning shaxsiy kabineti orqali ularga xabar beriladi.

Bitiruvchilar tomonidan topshirilgan hujjatlarning qalbakiligi aniqlanganda, u suhbatdan (talabalikka qabul qilingandan keyin aniqlansa, talabalikdan) chetlashtiriladi hamda hujjatlari belgilangan tartibda huquqni muhofaza qiluvchi o‘rganlarga yuboriladi.

The documents uploaded to the system by graduates who registered online are examined by the admission commissions of higher education institutions every year by August 5, and the results of the examination are communicated to the applicants through their personal accounts.

If the documents submitted by a graduate are found to be forged, the graduate is excluded from the interview (or, if this is discovered after admission, from the student body), and the documents are sent to the law enforcement authorities in the established order.

en.text: 11. Every year by August 10, the rector of the higher education institution (director of the branch) forms, by his or her order, a separate Interview Commission for each field of study.

en.text: The Interview Commission is formed of at least 9 members and includes responsible officials of organisations that are the main employers of personnel and of ministries and departments to which the higher education institution is subordinate, a highly qualified teacher of the technical college in the relevant field, and, as a rule, a professor-teacher of the higher education institution in the relevant field.

en.text: 12. The interview for admitting graduates who have successfully completed technical colleges to higher education institutions is held under full video surveillance, and the process is broadcast online, with sound, to a separate waiting area for parents and observers.

en.text: Responsibility for ensuring that the interview is held under full and high-quality video surveillance, and that the video recordings are stored at the higher education institution for at least three years, is assigned personally to the rector of the higher education institution (director of the branch).

en.text: 13. The interview for admitting graduates to higher education institutions is held every year from August 10 to August 25, within the period set by the higher education institution, provided that at least two thirds of the members of the Interview Commission take part.

en.text: The dates of the interview are announced on the official website of the higher education institution at least one week before the interviews begin.

en.text: 14. Graduates who do not come to the interview within the set time limits are not given a repeat interview for that academic year and are not admitted to the 2nd year of a bachelor’s degree programme of the higher education institution.

en.text: If a graduate cannot take part in the interview, or does not take part, for a valid reason (illness, a business trip or the death of a family member, confirmed by a document), he or she must apply to the admission commission formed at the higher education institution no later than three days after the date of the interview. For graduates of this category an additional interview is held within one week after the interview process has been fully completed.

en.text: The maximum total score that can be obtained is 100 points.

Information on those recommended for admission as students according to the interview results is submitted by the rector of the higher education institution (director of the branch) to the ministry or department to which it is subordinate within three days from the date the results are announced.
The interview result record sheets and the final result record sheets of the interview of the Interview Commission are stored at the higher education institution for three years.

The members of the Interview Commission are paid out of the extra-budgetary paid-contract funds of the higher education institution, under the conditions of hourly pay established for conducting classes with students of higher education institutions.

According to the final result record sheet of the interview approved by the Interview Commission, graduates are recommended by the rector of the higher education institution (director of the branch) for admission as students to continue their studies from the 2nd year of the bachelor’s degree programme corresponding to their field.
